question: Gaya and Nalanda 2022 2023 show institutional delivery and postnatal percentages of registrations

attempts.response:
```sql
WITH data AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    pregnancies_registered,
    institutional_deliveries,
    postnatal_check_48h,
    district
  FROM maternal_services
  WHERE
    district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND year IN (2022, 2023)
)
SELECT
  year,
  district,
  CAST(pregnancies_registered AS DOUBLE) / SUM(pregnancies_registered) OVER () AS pregnancies_registered_percentage,
  CAST(institutional_deliveries AS DOUBLE) / SUM(institutional_deliveries) OVER () AS institutional_deliveries_percentage,
  CAST(postnatal_check_48h AS DOUBLE) / SUM(postnatal_check_48h) OVER () AS postnatal_check_48h_percentage
FROM data
WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda');
```
